rules.name: Brute-force threshold
rules.logic: 4 or more failed logins for the same user/source IP within 120 seconds.

rules.name: Success after repeated failures
rules.logic: A successful login follows at least 3 recent failures for the same user/source IP.

rules.name: PowerShell execution
rules.logic: A PowerShell process starts on an endpoint; requires analyst context before escalation.
